Sankey traces

Source: R/zz-gen-figure.R, R/zz-gen-sankey.R
go_sankey.Rd

Sankey plots for network flow data analysis. The nodes are specified in `nodes` and the links between sources and targets in `links`. The colors are set in `nodes[i].color` and `links[i].color`, otherwise defaults are used.

Arguments

fig

A go_figure object.

...

Further properties, including nested properties in "magic underscore" form, e.g. marker_size = 10 for marker = list(size = 10). Property values may be one-sided formulas, evaluated in data for add_*() functions.

data

A data frame in which formula properties (e.g. x = ~col, marker_size = ~col) are evaluated. Default: the data given to go_figure(). Only the evaluated values are added to the trace.

arrangement

If value is `snap` (the default), the node arrangement is assisted by automatic snapping of elements to preserve space between nodes specified via `nodepad`. If value is `perpendicular`, the nodes can only move along a line perpendicular to the flow. If value is `freeform`, the nodes can freely move on the plane. If value is `fixed`, the nodes are stationary. One of "snap", "perpendicular", "freeform", "fixed".

customdata

go_sankey(): Assigns extra data each datum. This may be useful when listening to hover, click and selection events. Note that, "scatter" traces also appends customdata items in the markers DOM elements Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

go_sankey_link(): Assigns extra data to each link. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

go_sankey_node(): Assigns extra data to each node. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

direction

Sets the direction of the flow along the `orientation` axis. With `forward` (the default), sources are on the left (horizontal) or top (vertical). With `reversed`, sources are on the right (horizontal) or bottom (vertical). One of "forward", "reversed".

domain

Named list or go_sankey_domain() object.

hoverinfo

go_sankey(): Determines what trace information appears on hover. If `none` or `skip` are set, no information is displayed upon hovering. But, if `none` is set, click and hover events are still fired. Note that this attribute is superseded by `node.hoverinfo` and `node.hoverinfo` for nodes and links respectively. Any combination of "" joined with "+", or one of "all", "none", "skip".

go_sankey_link(): Determines what trace information appears when hovering links. If `none` or `skip` are set, no information is displayed upon hovering. But, if `none` is set, click and hover events are still fired. One of "all", "none", "skip".

go_sankey_node(): Determines what trace information appears when hovering nodes. If `none` or `skip` are set, no information is displayed upon hovering. But, if `none` is set, click and hover events are still fired. One of "all", "none", "skip".

hoverlabel

go_sankey(): Named list or go_sankey_hoverlabel() object.

go_sankey_link(): Named list or go_sankey_link_hoverlabel() object.

go_sankey_node(): Named list or go_sankey_node_hoverlabel() object.

ids

Assigns id labels to each datum. These ids for object constancy of data points during animation. Should be an array of strings, not numbers or any other type. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

legend

Sets the reference to a legend to show this trace in. References to these legends are "legend", "legend2", "legend3", etc. Settings for these legends are set in the layout, under `layout.legend`, `layout.legend2`, etc. Subplot id: "legend", "legend2", "legend3", ....

legendgrouptitle

Named list or go_sankey_legendgrouptitle() object.

legendrank

Sets the legend rank for this trace. Items and groups with smaller ranks are presented on top/left side while with "reversed" `legend.traceorder` they are on bottom/right side. The default legendrank is 1000, so that you can use ranks less than 1000 to place certain items before all unranked items, and ranks greater than 1000 to go after all unranked items. When having unranked or equal rank items shapes would be displayed after traces i.e. according to their order in data and layout. Number.

legendwidth

Sets the width (in px or fraction) of the legend for this trace. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

link

The links of the Sankey plot. Named list or go_sankey_link() object.

meta

Assigns extra meta information associated with this trace that can be used in various text attributes. Attributes such as trace `name`, graph, axis and colorbar `title.text`, annotation `text` `rangeselector`, `updatemenues` and `sliders` `label` text all support `meta`. To access the trace `meta` values in an attribute in the same trace, simply use `%{meta[i]}` where `i` is the index or key of the `meta` item in question. To access trace `meta` in layout attributes, use `%{data[n[.meta[i]}` where `i` is the index or key of the `meta` and `n` is the trace index. Any value.

name

go_sankey(): Sets the trace name. The trace name appears as the legend item and on hover. String.

go_sankey_link_concentrationscales(): When used in a template, named items are created in the output figure in addition to any items the figure already has in this array. You can modify these items in the output figure by making your own item with `templateitemname` matching this `name` alongside your modifications (including `visible: false` or `enabled: false` to hide it). Has no effect outside of a template. String.

node

The nodes of the Sankey plot. Named list or go_sankey_node() object.

orientation

Sets the orientation of the Sankey diagram. With `h` (the default), the flow runs horizontally. With `v`, the flow runs vertically. Use `direction` to control which side the sources are placed on. One of "v", "h".

selectedpoints

Array containing integer indices of selected points. Has an effect only for traces that support selections. Note that an empty array means an empty selection where the `unselected` are turned on for all points, whereas, any other non-array values means no selection all where the `selected` and `unselected` styles have no effect. Any value.

textfont

Sets the font for node labels Named list or go_sankey_textfont() object.

uid

Assign an id to this trace, Use this to provide object constancy between traces during animations and transitions. String.

uirevision

Controls persistence of some user-driven changes to the trace: `constraintrange` in `parcoords` traces, as well as some `editable: true` modifications such as `name` and `colorbar.title`. Defaults to `layout.uirevision`. Note that other user-driven trace attribute changes are controlled by `layout` attributes: `trace.visible` is controlled by `layout.legend.uirevision`, `selectedpoints` is controlled by `layout.selectionrevision`, and `colorbar.(x|y)` (accessible with `config: {editable: true}`) is controlled by `layout.editrevision`. Trace changes are tracked by `uid`, which only falls back on trace index if no `uid` is provided. So if your app can add/remove traces before the end of the `data` array, such that the same trace has a different index, you can still preserve user-driven changes if you give each trace a `uid` that stays with it as it moves. Any value.

valueformat

Sets the value formatting rule using d3 formatting mini-languages which are very similar to those in Python. For numbers, see: https://github.com/d3/d3-format/tree/v1.4.5#d3-format. String.

valuesuffix

Adds a unit to follow the value in the hover tooltip. Add a space if a separation is necessary from the value. String.

visible

Determines whether or not this trace is visible. If "legendonly", the trace is not drawn, but can appear as a legend item (provided that the legend itself is visible). One of "legendonly", TRUE, FALSE.

row

add_sankey(): Subplot grid row (figures created with make_subplots() only). May be "all" or a vector to address several cells.

go_sankey_domain(): If there is a layout grid, use the domain for this row in the grid for this sankey trace. Integer in the interval [0, Inf].

col

Subplot grid column (figures created with make_subplots() only). May be "all" or a vector to address several cells.

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from (constructors). Named arguments take precedence.

column

If there is a layout grid, use the domain for this column in the grid for this sankey trace. Integer in the interval [0, Inf].

x

go_sankey_domain(): Sets the horizontal domain of this sankey trace (in plot fraction). Vector or list of 2 element(s).

go_sankey_node(): The normalized horizontal position of the node. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

y

go_sankey_domain(): Sets the vertical domain of this sankey trace (in plot fraction). Vector or list of 2 element(s).

go_sankey_node(): The normalized vertical position of the node. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

align

go_sankey_hoverlabel(), go_sankey_link_hoverlabel(), go_sankey_node_hoverlabel(): Sets the horizontal alignment of the text content within hover label box. Has an effect only if the hover label text spans two or more lines One of "left", "right", "auto", or a vector of these.

go_sankey_node(): Sets the alignment method used to position the nodes along the horizontal axis. One of "justify", "left", "right", "center".

bgcolor

Sets the background color of the hover labels for this trace Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

bordercolor

Sets the border color of the hover labels for this trace. Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

font

go_sankey_hoverlabel(): Sets the font used in hover labels. Named list or go_sankey_hoverlabel_font() object.

go_sankey_legendgrouptitle(): Sets this legend group's title font. Named list or go_sankey_legendgrouptitle_font() object.

go_sankey_link_hoverlabel(): Sets the font used in hover labels. Named list or go_sankey_link_hoverlabel_font() object.

go_sankey_node_hoverlabel(): Sets the font used in hover labels. Named list or go_sankey_node_hoverlabel_font() object.

namelength

Sets the default length (in number of characters) of the trace name in the hover labels for all traces. -1 shows the whole name regardless of length. 0-3 shows the first 0-3 characters, and an integer >3 will show the whole name if it is less than that many characters, but if it is longer, will truncate to `namelength - 3` characters and add an ellipsis. Integer in the interval [-1, Inf], or a vector of these.

showarrow

Sets whether or not to show the hover label arrow/triangle pointing to the data point. Logical.

color

go_sankey_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_link_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_node_hoverlabel_font(): Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

go_sankey_legendgrouptitle_font(), go_sankey_textfont(): Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

go_sankey_link(): Sets the `link` color. It can be a single value, or an array for specifying color for each `link`. If `link.color` is omitted, then by default, a translucent grey link will be used. Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

go_sankey_link_line(): Sets the color of the `line` around each `link`. Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

go_sankey_node(): Sets the `node` color. It can be a single value, or an array for specifying color for each `node`. If `node.color` is omitted, then the default `Plotly` color palette will be cycled through to have a variety of colors. These defaults are not fully opaque, to allow some visibility of what is beneath the node. Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

go_sankey_node_line(): Sets the color of the `line` around each `node`. Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

family

go_sankey_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_link_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_node_hoverlabel_font(): HTML font family - the typeface that will be applied by the web browser. The web browser can only apply a font if it is available on the system where it runs. Provide multiple font families, separated by commas, to indicate the order in which to apply fonts if they aren't available. String, or a vector of these.

go_sankey_legendgrouptitle_font(), go_sankey_textfont(): HTML font family - the typeface that will be applied by the web browser. The web browser can only apply a font if it is available on the system where it runs. Provide multiple font families, separated by commas, to indicate the order in which to apply fonts if they aren't available. String.

lineposition

go_sankey_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_link_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_node_hoverlabel_font(): Sets the kind of decoration line(s) with text, such as an "under", "over" or "through" as well as combinations e.g. "under+over", etc. Any combination of "under", "over", "through" joined with "+", or one of "none", or a vector of these.

go_sankey_legendgrouptitle_font(), go_sankey_textfont(): Sets the kind of decoration line(s) with text, such as an "under", "over" or "through" as well as combinations e.g. "under+over", etc. Any combination of "under", "over", "through" joined with "+", or one of "none".

shadow

go_sankey_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_link_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_node_hoverlabel_font(): Sets the shape and color of the shadow behind text. "auto" places minimal shadow and applies contrast text font color. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/text-shadow for additional options. String, or a vector of these.

go_sankey_legendgrouptitle_font(), go_sankey_textfont(): Sets the shape and color of the shadow behind text. "auto" places minimal shadow and applies contrast text font color. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/text-shadow for additional options. String.

size

go_sankey_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_link_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_node_hoverlabel_font(): Number in the interval [1, Inf], or a vector of these.

go_sankey_legendgrouptitle_font(), go_sankey_textfont(): Number in the interval [1, Inf].

style

go_sankey_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_link_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_node_hoverlabel_font(): Sets whether a font should be styled with a normal or italic face from its family. One of "normal", "italic", or a vector of these.

go_sankey_legendgrouptitle_font(), go_sankey_textfont(): Sets whether a font should be styled with a normal or italic face from its family. One of "normal", "italic".

textcase

go_sankey_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_link_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_node_hoverlabel_font(): Sets capitalization of text. It can be used to make text appear in all-uppercase or all-lowercase, or with each word capitalized. One of "normal", "word caps", "upper", "lower", or a vector of these.

go_sankey_legendgrouptitle_font(), go_sankey_textfont(): Sets capitalization of text. It can be used to make text appear in all-uppercase or all-lowercase, or with each word capitalized. One of "normal", "word caps", "upper", "lower".

variant

go_sankey_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_link_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_node_hoverlabel_font(): Sets the variant of the font. One of "normal", "small-caps", "all-small-caps", "all-petite-caps", "petite-caps", "unicase", or a vector of these.

go_sankey_legendgrouptitle_font(), go_sankey_textfont(): Sets the variant of the font. One of "normal", "small-caps", "all-small-caps", "all-petite-caps", "petite-caps", "unicase".

weight

go_sankey_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_link_hoverlabel_font(), go_sankey_node_hoverlabel_font(): Sets the weight (or boldness) of the font. Integer in the interval [1, 1000], or a vector of these.

go_sankey_legendgrouptitle_font(), go_sankey_textfont(): Sets the weight (or boldness) of the font. Integer in the interval [1, 1000].

text

Sets the title of the legend group. String.

arrowlen

Sets the length (in px) of the links arrow, if 0 no arrow will be drawn. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

colorscales

List of named lists or go_sankey_link_concentrationscales() objects.

hovercolor

Sets the `link` hover color. It can be a single value, or an array for specifying hover colors for each `link`. If `link.hovercolor` is omitted, then by default, links will become slightly more opaque when hovered over. Color: a CSS color string or R color name, or a vector of these.

hovertemplate

Template string used for rendering the information that appear on hover box. Note that this will override `hoverinfo`. Variables are inserted using %{variable}, for example "y: %{y}" as well as %{xother}, {%_xother}, {%_xother_}, {%xother_}. When showing info for several points, "xother" will be added to those with different x positions from the first point. An underscore before or after "(x|y)other" will add a space on that side, only when this field is shown. Numbers are formatted using d3-format's syntax %{variable:d3-format}, for example "Price: %{y:$.2f}". https://github.com/d3/d3-format/tree/v1.4.5#d3-format for details on the formatting syntax. Dates are formatted using d3-time-format's syntax %{variable|d3-time-format}, for example "Day: %{2019-01-01|%A}". https://github.com/d3/d3-time-format/tree/v2.2.3#locale_format for details on the date formatting syntax. Variables that can't be found will be replaced with the specifier. For example, a template of "data: %{x}, %{y}" will result in a value of "data: 1, %{y}" if x is 1 and y is missing. Variables with an undefined value will be replaced with the fallback value. The variables available in `hovertemplate` are the ones emitted as event data described at this link https://plotly.com/javascript/plotlyjs-events/#event-data. Additionally, all attributes that can be specified per-point (the ones that are `arrayOk: true`) are available. Finally, the template string has access to variables `value` and `label`. Anything contained in tag `<extra>` is displayed in the secondary box, for example `<extra>%{fullData.name}</extra>`. To hide the secondary box completely, use an empty tag `<extra></extra>`. String, or a vector of these.

hovertemplatefallback

Fallback string that's displayed when a variable referenced in a template is missing. If the boolean value 'false' is passed in, the specifier with the missing variable will be displayed. Any value.

label

go_sankey_link(): The shown name of the link. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

go_sankey_link_concentrationscales(): The label of the links to color based on their concentration within a flow. String.

go_sankey_node(): The shown name of the node. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

line

go_sankey_link(): Named list or go_sankey_link_line() object.

go_sankey_node(): Named list or go_sankey_node_line() object.

sort

go_sankey_link(): For `auto` (the default), the order of links attached to each node is determined automatically by the layout. For `input`, the order of links at each node is kept the same as the order in the input array. One of "auto", "input".

go_sankey_node(): For `auto` (the default), the vertical order of nodes will be determined automatically by the layout. For `input`, the vertical order of nodes is kept the same as the order in the input array. One of "auto", "input".

source

An integer number `[0..nodes.length - 1]` that represents the source node. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

target

An integer number `[0..nodes.length - 1]` that represents the target node. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

value

A numeric value representing the flow volume value. Data array: a vector, factor, Date/POSIXct vector, matrix or list.

cmax

Sets the upper bound of the color domain. Number.

cmin

Sets the lower bound of the color domain. Number.

colorscale

Sets the colorscale. The colorscale must be an array containing arrays mapping a normalized value to an rgb, rgba, hex, hsl, hsla, hwb, or named color string. At minimum, a mapping for the lowest (0) and highest (1) values are required. For example, `[[0, 'rgb(0,0,255)'], [1, 'rgb(255,0,0)']]`. To control the bounds of the colorscale in color space, use `cmin` and `cmax`. Alternatively, `colorscale` may be a palette name string of the following list: Blackbody,Bluered,Blues,Cividis,Earth,Electric,Greens,Greys,Hot,Jet,Picnic,Portland,Rainbow,RdBu,Reds,Viridis,YlGnBu,YlOrRd. Colorscale: a vector of colors, a two-column data.frame of (value, color), or the name of a sequential, diverging or cyclical scale in px_colors() (append "_r" to reverse).

templateitemname

Used to refer to a named item in this array in the template. Named items from the template will be created even without a matching item in the input figure, but you can modify one by making an item with `templateitemname` matching its `name`, alongside your modifications (including `visible: false` or `enabled: false` to hide it). If there is no template or no matching item, this item will be hidden unless you explicitly show it with `visible: true`. String.

width

go_sankey_link_line(): Sets the width (in px) of the `line` around each `link`. Number in the interval [0, Inf], or a vector of these.

go_sankey_node_line(): Sets the width (in px) of the `line` around each `node`. Number in the interval [0, Inf], or a vector of these.

groups

Groups of nodes. Each group is defined by an array with the indices of the nodes it contains. Multiple groups can be specified. Vector or list of up to 1 element(s).

pad

Sets the padding (in px) between the `nodes`. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

thickness

Sets the thickness (in px) of the `nodes`. Number in the interval [1, Inf].

Value

Each go_*() function returns a graph object of the same class as its name; add_*() functions return the modified figure.

Details

go_sankey() and the nested object constructors below create validated graph objects (named lists). Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when an object is created or modified (see plotly_obj-modify()). add_sankey() creates an object and adds it to a figure.

Nested objects documented here:

go_sankey_domain()

sankey.domain

go_sankey_hoverlabel()

sankey.hoverlabel

go_sankey_hoverlabel_font()

sankey.hoverlabel.font: Sets the font used in hover labels.

go_sankey_legendgrouptitle()

sankey.legendgrouptitle
